represents: CI/CD and in-cluster workload traffic in one production AWS account: GitHub Actions workflows assuming deploy roles through the GitHub OIDC provider with pinned subjects (repo + environment / branch / pull_request) from GitHub-hosted runner addresses and pushing images, artifacts and deployments; and EKS IRSA service accounts (load-balancer controller, external-dns, cluster-autoscaler, EBS CSI, Karpenter, external-secrets, an application, a self-hosted ARC runner) exchanging projected tokens and calling AWS from the cluster's NAT egress (203.0.113.0/28, the repo's own-egress placeholder), pod private IPs through VPC interface endpoints, and IPv6 (2001:db8::/32) egress.
provenance: synthetic; shapes from the AWS CloudTrail record contents / userIdentity reference, the STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity CloudTrail example, the S3 data-event reference, and this repo's TRR9022 and TRR9015 fixtures (detections/cloud/fixtures/trr9022, trr9015). User agents follow the published SDK user-agent formats. Session tokens are placeholders; access-key ids are ASIAEXAMPLE<digits>; account 123456789012; addresses are RFC 5737 / RFC 1918 / 2001:db8::/32. GitHub-hosted runners are modelled in 192.0.2.128/25.
